Sunrise Sunset Widget is a beautiful Sun Tracker app with a unique way to view and interact with the the daily cycles of the Sun. Spin the disk to change the time of day, or 5 days into the future. The app will show the sunrise, sunset, twilight, day length, golden hour, UV Index and more! 

This is also a fully featured weather app! Hit the "weather switch" to see the temperature, precipitation, wind speed and humidity, combined with the solar disk.

If you're interested in photography, you can enable "Golden Hour", to easily see when this special "hour" begins and ends.

You can also choose between a multitude of beautiful colour themes, and configure the looks of both the app and widget.

In the calendar page, you can check the sun information for any date throught the year. Tap a date to view even more solar information. 

Tap the Places page to change the location you are interested in. The app works anywhere in the world!

By using the accompanying home screen widget you can also get all this information on your home screen!

Get notified when the sun rises and sets, how long the day and night will be, and the time difference from yesterday.
